meta.source: Office of the New York State Comptroller, New York's Balance of Payments in the Federal Budget, Federal Fiscal Year 2024
meta.omitted: The Comptroller's civilian/military wage split is not shown: in the published workbook it does not reconcile to the wage totals.
meta.note: Covers the 50 states and D.C. Net interest on the debt, customs duties, overseas spending and other amounts that cannot be assigned to a state are excluded.
